content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must submit their application in the attached format through Speed Post or Registered Post. The envelope must be superscribed on the top with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF NON-TECHNICAL CONSULTANT ON CONTRACT BASIS". Send the postal application to Electronics Test & Development Centre (ETDC)/Centre For Reliability (CFR), Dr. VSI Estate, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041. Candidates must also send a copy of the application by email to [email protected] along with attested copies of Age Proof, Pension Payment Order/Last Pay Certificate to Electronics Test & Development Centre & Centre For Reliability (ETDC/CFR), Dr.VSI Estate, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Criteria: Candidates must have retired from Central Government Ministries or Departments having experience of functioning in Government bodies, specifically having retired from Non-S&T (Group B) posts at ASO Level (Level 6). Age Limit: Not more than 63 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application (10 November 2026). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a short-term contract basis initially for a period of one year, which may be extended up to five years after superannuation based on performance review and requirement.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for this consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired Central Government employees who retired from Non-S&T Group B posts at ASO Level (Level 6) with experience in Government bodies can apply, provided they are not more than 63 years of age.

faq.question: Q3. How is the remuneration calculated for retired officers?
faq.answer: A fixed monthly amount is admissible, arrived at by deducting the Basic Pension (uncommuted) from the last basic pay drawn at the time of retirement.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach attested copies of Age Proof, Pension Payment Order (PPO) or Last Pay Certificate (LPC), and educational or technical certificate copies along with the filled application format.
